critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1546 lines — the social block (search/request/respond/list/leaderboard/feed/notifications, lines 1284-1427) plus the ORS circuits router should be split into `routers/social.py` and `routers/circuits.py` for maintainability.

GET /api/notifications internally calls list_friends (dependency-injected user) then re-queries the same friendship rels via accepted_friend_ids — two round trips where one aggregated fetch would do. Fine at current scale.
GET /api/friends/leaderboard aggregates in Python over up to 1000 runs; if user counts grow, an $group aggregation pipeline would be more efficient and avoid loading raw run docs.

Deprecation warning still surfaces in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely from an inner Card/Pressable in the RN web build. Non-blocking but worth chasing when it's convenient.
seed_data_creation: Each request/refuse test registers a throwaway TEST_temp_/TEST_refuse_/TEST_stranger_ user (prefixed) via /api/auth/register — no plan generated, no runs seeded, so credit cost is nil. Users are not deleted at teardown because there is no admin DELETE endpoint; they remain harmless in DB. Existing thomas ↔ lea accepted friendship + Léa's 3 seeded runs (used for feed/leaderboard/friend-run access) are untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Login testIDs: auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button. Iter 8 regression baseline: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_social.py (11 tests, ~5s). Iteration 8 introduces 8 new endpoints (users/search, friends/request, friends/respond, friends CRUD, friends/leaderboard, friends/feed, notifications, plus the /runs/{id} friend-scoped branch) and 3 new screens (friends.tsx, activity.tsx, notifications.tsx) — all covered. /run/active requires ctx.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) + set_geolocation to reveal zombie-toggle / run-start / sos-button (otherwise the run-allow-location gate is shown). Web preview never triggers the bg-allow/bg-skip modal (background permission is native-only), so the run-start button transitions directly to the running state. Léa's seeded run ids can be discovered via /api/friends/feed at runtime — do NOT hardcode them.
